terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The terms for using emigisha.com and the apps run by Emigisha, LLC.
terms.intro: These terms cover emigisha.com and the apps run by Emigisha, LLC: Talatala, StyledDoc, PrettyCV and any other app that links to these terms. When you create an account or use one of these apps, you agree to them.

who.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Emigisha, LLC ("Emigisha", "we") is a Delaware limited liability company.
An app may add its own rules on its site, such as how its credits work. For that app, those rules apply on top of these terms.

account.title: Your account
paragraphs: You must be 18 or older. Give accurate details, keep your password safe, and tell us if someone else gets into your account. You are responsible for what happens in it.

content.title: Your content
paragraphs: What you upload stays yours. You let us store and process it only to run the app for you.
Only upload content you have the right to use. If it shows another person, you must have their explicit consent.

notAllowed.title: What you may not do
items: Break the law, or use our apps to harm someone
Upload content that is not yours to use
Impersonate anyone, or make misleading images of real people
Try to break, overload or get around the security of our apps
Scrape, copy or resell our apps or what they produce at scale

ai.title: AI results
paragraphs: Our apps use AI. Results can be wrong or unexpected. Check them before you rely on them or share them, especially CVs, documents and photos of people.

payments.title: Payments
paragraphs: Prices are shown before you pay, in the currency shown at checkout. We take card payments through Stripe and mobile money through pawaPay. Credits expire as each app states.
Refunds follow our Refund Policy at emigisha.com/refunds.

availability.title: Changes and availability
paragraphs: We improve our apps often, and may change or stop a feature or an app. If we stop a paid app, we refund unused credits.
We do our best to keep things running, but the apps are provided "as is", without warranties of any kind.

liability.title: Liability
paragraphs: We are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, such as lost profits or lost data. Our total liability is limited to the greater of what you paid us in the 12 months before the claim or US$100.
Nothing in these terms limits liability that the law does not allow us to limit.

ending.title: Ending
paragraphs: You can stop using an app and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms or puts the apps or other people at risk.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: If we make an important change, we tell you by email or in the app before it applies.
